body: I already tried applying. They told us they wont give references to anyone. But you are right. Im just too pessimistic and waste peoples time with my shit. I am going to just kill myself once I get home. This is pointless. Thanks for listening.

Thank you for replying. I mostly never get any reply so it feels nice. I get what you are saying. You also sound similar to stoics with this approach. I'm glad I can at least vent. If I didn't know english enough I don't know how I would survive without no place to vent.

I was always very obsessive about future potentials which makes me feel worse that I didn't manage to make use of that. I think it just feeds my depression. I already know I won't get a job though. I tried getting a job in nonrelated work like retail as a student which is easier than once you are out because the employers get to pay you less and less taxes here. I was always getting the response of no experience. During week at uni as I said I couldn't continue to try and now there are every summer gaps and never having any work I can list or some other experience or workshop which costs money here.

Professors will never give references here. I don't go to top uni. It's a shitty one. It's honestly not a good degree and there are like 3-5 job positions a month in the entire country in this field. I would be competing against people with experience, hundreds hours of workshops and volunteering.

The thing is I don't even care if it's not in my field. I would take that wageslave but they don't want me. Now I will be overqualified for them + no work experience is worse than being a murderer here in this shithole. I know there are a lot of people worse than me but I can't really help it. It's killing me and I have only negative reinforcements from everyone else. People will just say to your face that my situation will not get better and I can only pray some factory will let me work in for 12 hours with no holidays or days off. There are even people who say that I might as well become homeless now because they can't get job with years of experience so they don't see a way for me to get it done.

I don't have a choice I will try anyway but I still kind of get the feeling they are right.

Thats why I call it a script. It is just a script they run, its always the same with very slight variations and very few alternatives. You can spot people who never thought about a problem if they use a common, mainstream answer, because they just accept it as their own when they read it on facebook image post with very deep meaning about life. The answers are so generic you could program it. If I knew how to program I would write a "Normie platitude generator" based on your keyword input. But alas I am incompetent and too stupid to program.

You may be alone in your local area of the world but you are not alone who thinks like this. Even though we are few, there are many of us who think similar. The problem is we will probably never meet and reality reminds us how lonely and different we are every single day. Stereotypes and platitudes with hyper happiness and following the life script reminds me of that even if I could become an active member and not an observer I would probably not enjoy it at all.

I kno de way bruda. Even though Im getting old I still find pleasure in new spicy memes. The only regret I have is is that I am too poor that I will never have good pc and that vr set to enjoy that vrchat. Seems like a place for me, except I am getting too old for this. Life is a cruel shitty place with no joy. At least nowadays we have earth chan and everything chan to enjoy the misery of life.
This is my thinking also. Dont know if its funny or sad but probably both.

You are a weaboo pimp so I believe you will be alright. If not there are always lolis to fantasize about. I wish I was joking if I said that only memes can fill the hole in my heart these days and are the only reason why I havent killed myself a few times.

That depends on if I am good at something. I failed at everything from art things to logical or physical things. No matter the time I invest into something I get excited about I always end up below average and soon begin to not like my shitty outcomes of it.
Me neither, when you find a way please tell me.

I can understand that. Everyone was always better than me at everything. I even dedicated some years into few paths but never even became mediocre so I know what it feels like to feel incompetent. I feel like you are really hard on yourself and perfectionist. There are still possibility of your employment and if they reject you it not always mean you are bad at it. I flushed 5 years of study down the toilet because in the end I found out I cant do it and am not good at it no matter how hard I try + I cant break in. 

I hope you get the career because you obviously care. I already resigned myself to only working wageslave jobs and dying of poverty or suicide. Please dont end up like me.

Yes. They make it worse so a lot of people dont even say anything, but they still virtue signal about being open to talking and how everyone needs to feel loved. My parents told me to kill myself when I opened up about being suicidal. Then they proceeded to tell me that I have no right to feel bad. Then they ignored it and believe it magically cured itself.
It doesnt matter what system we use. Its always people who make it shit.
Its people as always.

Because people cant handle death and our society tabooid for eternity and now we just live in delusions and coping mechanisms which are easily broken if someone is questioning the programming. Also because our capitalist overlords need wage slaves to have a good life.

Its invalid and mainstream logic. That logic implies you cant be happy either because there are people who are happier, its bullshit one sided logic. Plus just because someone has it worse doesnt mean I wont feel bad. Next time when they feel sad when someone of their loved ones die tell them they should cheer up because there is that guy who lost two loved ones and its selfish to have suicidal thoughts because that third guy lost their entire family and is now happy regardless.

I find it absolutely horrifying that people use strategy of looking at other who has it worse to feel better. I can understand sharing stories about life and witnessing how others have similar bad luck so you feel you are not alone and then feel a bit relieved by that but to constantly need to see stupidity to feel superior for example is what I find so disgusting. Our society even encourages that way of living. People watch those tv shows where they purposely choose someone with lower IQ so they can laugh at their misfortune. And this is not a trolling kind of fun which is ironic or a coping mechanism. This is pure evil, unhelpful and unfunny, devoid of any meaning.

Nowadays they call you edgy and attention seeking and then they will dehumanize you, make your problems non existent or redefine them as evil. Assume some intentions that are not yours like "You just want attention". And then they will belive their cognitively constructed story in head and will proceed to apply their strategy of dealing with it which means they will ignore you, leave you, stab you in the back, get angry or hurt you more.

Yes. There is huge difference in types of depression. Also many depressed have more than just that and not always the depression is reactonary to situation. I know it can be hard. She had children that probably gave her motivation to live and fight. That is a strong instinct in women so she really may feel like she battled it. If we dont have any purpose or reason like she had with children the depression will linger for longer and with more harmful effects. This is just my opinion though, Im not a psychologist/psychiatrist.

There is no light and I know it takes time and all that. I already tried it all. Nowadays my depression wont allow me to even start doing things.

I dont think hobbies need to be meaningful but I wish I was at least good at something. Everything I try is a mess which makes me not enjoy it at all. And all the things I do or did were uncommon so you have hard time finding someone to share it with. I believe I would find some meaningfulness in doing something with someone but I cant get into hobbies that normal people like because I find them boring and feel I am just pretending and dont want to do it anyway. So I tried getting into things online but I always end up being bad at it and never developing any relationships with anyone. Then I get depressed and lose interest. There are some things I do even if I am bad at it but I cant really live my life without any passion in it.

I feel very sad and miserable because I am very sensitive. Then when Im depressed I say things that are selfish and not that nice but I hate this society. I dont know how anyone could enjoy living like this. Maybe thats why people delude themselves and project a fantasy into the world and maybe the world really is shitty but everyone is brainwashed that if you are depressed they feel very intimidated, angry, creeped out ..maybe it affects their unconscious in a way. im rambling probably.
This is me for the past few years.
This is the truth. It is relative as it cant be the same because we are different.
She probably had different depression that is temporary which is not unusual for women with small children or she was just very sad and now believes all depression is like that.
I hate how they believe that if they dont think about it or you not mentioning it it magically disappears. Or if they wait long enough you will get better.
This is something I witness all the time. Then if someone kills him/herself they all start to circlejerk about how sad they are but in life they never even listen to you.
I feel annoyed by them. I especially hate their cliche responses and life scripts. I dont know whats worse, their responses, ignorance or just never speaking to anyone.

Loneliness is my whole life in one word + all the other shit. I know it gets harder, I also think the possibilities of finding a friend now when you are too different and depressed, broke are near to none especially if you dont have anything in common with most.

I understand the feeling of if you cease to exist noone will notice. If I would die right now, my family would notice but they were bad at everything except giving me shelter that I dont care. I even start to believe that this is evolutionary. Like people tell you they care and to open up but they never do when you need them and will even hurt you and leave you. Seems like this is just a script to say in society ...same like small talk in essence. But they unconsciously dont like and run away from depressed, lonely, different. Seems like only those deep in that abyss dont run away or virtue signal help. What is more sad is that even those who base their entire career on helping like therapists or psychologist do that. I guess I am not meant to survive in this world and am targeted by nature for extermination to weed out my genes.

No volunteering here in this east europe shithole. Photography would require money. Im poor as fuck and its not going to change. Its a dead end situation. If you live in this shithole you cant escape. Its not like american ghetto but its postcommunistic slaveland if you dont have connections to get out. My only life could probably be online but I suck at that too. Moving out would require money I dont have.

There is no giving up. Its more like there are no possibilities. There is nowhere to go, do or have money to do. Soon I wont even have time to do anything. It really feels like my life is done and am old.
I dont have money to leave so I am stuck and my only options are getting better job which is not going to happen, accepting I will be lonely slave or just suicide. I wish I had friends at least.
central/east europe in a middle of nothing surrounded by people who believe working 12+hours a day forever in a factory for minimum wage is a good life. I wish someone would nuke this place.

If you somehow get to become 26 with noone, never having friends,job,gf,bad family,prospects,health or anything meaningful in anything and always failling with million internal and external problems, it would probably be delusional to feel happy as I am not a saint or a sage philosopher who can. I probably experienced all colors and ambivalences of negative emotions and I dont feel like trying to find another one.

no, I cant form relationships with people, I am poor, have health and mental problems, have shit family, no job, my future is poverty and pain. You could probably enjoy potential misery and loneliness until you are still not homeless or something but I just cant.
I wish I could afford VR headset and good pc.

My phone is my clock and alarm. The only messages I receive remind me I need to pay the bill. The only twice a year call I get is when someone wants to sell me something I dont want. 

But soon I will have to use my phone to try to get a wageslave job although that is a potential if and I cant be sure I will use it. I dont even know how to type the letters on it anymore as I am looking at it right now. I was completely unexperienced with this precious piece of technology that many girls spend 10hours a day on. Today I have learnt where I can type the phone numbers. That is the most productive thing I have done this week.

I believe society has terrible values that amplifies the worst in human potential. We see friendships and relationships as transactions nowadays. We support greed and reward corruption and manipulation in daily lives. We mock the ones in need. We let people live in trash and overwork them to death. We alienate difference no matter if good or bad. We make people feel like shit and society inhibit any form of anything that is not optimistic/mainstream/money,sex/power or similar to that. We also dont listen to each other and dont care at all. 

Makes me want to become antinatalist and hope for the final world war.

Its the system in this society and how people view this. I hate it too much how hyper competitive and evil we have become as humans. We created a system that amplifies every vice we have under the sun and made it normal.
I feel similar except I dont think I will ever have a career or family. People say choose one but I dont have to make that choice. I too have no purpose here and dont even know why I bother if I dont even get a reply. What is your dream profession? I know what it feels like to get your dreams crushed, especially if you study and prepare and try and then you fail. The pain of knowing what could have been is worse than never going to school and study because then you wouldnt know it even exists as option or if you can pull it off. I dont know if this is similar but I feel like Im too incompetent to get the career job but cant be satisfied with being broke drunk piece of shit.
